senses.gloss:
रुश् (cf. √ रुष् and रिश्) cl. 6. P. (Dhātup. xxviii, 126) रुश॑ति (pf. रुरोश; fut. रोष्टा, रोक्ष्यति; aor. अरुक्षत् Gr.; only pr. p. रुश॑त्, q.v.),
to hurt, injure, annoy (हिंसायाम्, Dhātup.) :
Caus. रोशयति (aor. अरूरुशत्) Gr.:
Desid. रुरुक्षति, ib. :
Intens. रोरुश्यते, रोरोष्टि, ib.
2. रुष् f. (nom. रुट्, Siddh.) anger, wrath, rage, fury, passion, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
1. रुश॑त् mf(अ॑न्ती or अती)n. cropping, browsing on AV. iv, 21, 7 (RV. रिश॑न्ती)
hurting, injuring, mortifying, detestable, disagreeable, AV.; Kauś.; MBh. (v.l. रुषत्), BhP.
2. रु॑शत् mf(अती)n. (cf. √ 1. रुच्) brilliant, shining, bright, white, RV.
रुषत् mf(अती)n. (cf. 1. रुशत्) hurting, injuring, displeasing, MBh.; Hariv.
रुशङ्गु m. (cf. रुषङ्गु and रुशद्-गु) N. of a Ṛṣi, Cat. (v.l. नृषङ्गु).
रुषङ्गु m. N. of a Brāhman, MBh. (prob. w.r. for रुशद्-गु).
रु॑शत्—पशु (रु॑शत्-), mfn. having white cattle, RV.
रु॑शद् in comp. for 2. रु॑शत्.
रुषद् in comp. for रुषत्.
रु॑शद्—ऊर्मि (रु॑शद्-), mfn. having glistening waves, RV.
रु॑शद्—गु (रु॑शद्-), mfn. having white or bright cattle, ib.
रु॑शद्—गु m. N. of a man (cf. रुशङ्गु, रुषङ्गु).
रुषद्—गु m. N. of a king, VP. (prob. w.r. for रुशद्-गु).
रुशद्—रथ m. ‘having a white chariot’, N. of a prince, BhP.
रुषद्—रथ m. N. of a king, ib. (v.l. उषद्-रथ; cf. रुशद्-र्˚).
रु॑शद्—वत्स (रु॑-शद्-), mfn. having white calves, RV.
रुशना f. N. of one of the wives of Rudra, BhP.
रु॑शम m. (or रुश॑म) N. of a man, RV.
(रुश॑मास्), pl. his descendants, ib.
रु॑शमा (आ), f. N. of a woman (said to have contended with Indra as to which of the two would run fastest round the earth, and to have won by the artifice of only going round Kuru-kṣetra), PañcavBr.
रुशेकु m. N. of a king, BhP. (v.l. रुषद्रु, उषद्गु, ऋषद्गु &c.)
रुषा f. = 2. रुष् (mostly ifc.)
रूष m. bitter and sour taste, L.
रूष mf(आ)n. bitter and sour, L. (cf. रूक्ष).
रुषा˚न्वित (रुषान्व्˚) mfn. filled with anger, full of wrath, MW.
रुषित mfn. injured, offended, irritated, furious, angry, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
रूषित mfn. (sometimes confounded with रुषित) strewed, covered, soiled, smeared with (comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
adhering to (comp.), BhP.
perfumed with (comp.), MBh.
pounded, reduced to powder, L.
adorned, decorated, L.
= नष्ट, Prab., Sch.
made rough or rugged (cf. रूक्ष), W.
रुष्ट mfn. id., ib.
रुष्ट m. N. of a Muni, Cat.
रुष्टि—मत् mfn. g. मध्व्-आदि.
रुष्य g., मध्व्-आदि.
रु˚ष्य-मत् g., मध्व्-आदि.
रूषक m. Gendarussa Vulgaris, L.
रूषण n. covering, strewing, Chandom.
soiling, L.
adorning, decoration, MW.
